content.title: NTN 6209 Open Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 45mm Bore x 85mm OD x 19mm Width
content.short_description: NTN 6209 open-type deep groove ball bearing with 45 mm bore, 85 mm outer diameter, and 19 mm width. Steel cage, static load rating 21.6 kN.
content.long_description:
The NTN 6209 is a single-row deep groove ball bearing sized for a 45 mm bore, 85 mm outer diameter, and 19 mm width. It is supplied in an open configuration, with no integrated seals or shields on either side, allowing for direct lubrication access and inspection of the internal raceway and ball complement.

Internally, the bearing uses a steel cage to retain and space the ball complement within the inner and outer ring races. The steel cage construction supports operation across standard industrial speed ranges typical of this bearing series.

Static load rating (C0) for the 6209 is 21.6 kN, indicating the permissible static load the bearing can withstand without incurring impermissible permanent deformation at contact points between the balls and raceways. This rating should be checked against actual application loads, including mounting and shock loads, when selecting this bearing for a given assembly.

As an open bearing, the 6209 is typically installed in housings or applications where external sealing arrangements are provided separately, or where the operating environment does not require an integral seal or shield. Standard mounting practices for 6200-series metric deep groove ball bearings apply.
